title: Kusche and Steyn Shatter Records and Cash In at 2026 Comrades Marathon
claims: The 2026 Comrades Marathon was run on Sunday 14 June 2026 in Pietermaritzburg, South Africa, the 99th edition and the 50th Up Run, from Durban to Pietermaritzburg.

George Kusche won the 2026 men's race in 5:15:56, breaking the previous Up Run record of 5:24:49 set by Leonid Shvetsov (Russia) in 2008; his average pace was 3:40.99 per kilometre, beating the Best Average Time of 3:43.75/km set by Vladimir Kotov in 2000.
Men's top five: 2nd Piet Wiersma (Netherlands) 5:19:36, 3rd Mbuti Mollo (South Africa) 5:21:31, 4th Alex Milne (Great Britain) 5:22:29, 5th Haruki Okayama (Japan) 5:24:46.
Gerda Steyn won the 2026 women's race in 5:44:53, improving her own women's Up Run record of 5:49:46 set in 2024; her average pace was 4:01.24 per kilometre, beating her own 2024 best of 4:04.28/km.
Women's top five: 2nd Nobukhosi Tshuma (Zimbabwe) 5:53:36, 3rd Irvette van Zyl (South Africa) 6:02:30, 4th Shelmith Muruiki (Kenya) 6:06:38, 5th Naomi Robinson (Great Britain) 6:07:55.
The 2026 route was 85.777 km, 133 metres shorter than in 2024 and the shortest Up Run distance in recorded history; there were 18,523 finishers.

Each 2026 winner earned R2,322,000 in total, comprising R925,000 first-place prize money including the Cell C top-up, R242,000 as the first South African finisher, a R605,000 Up Run record incentive bonus, and the R550,000 Cell C average-pace incentive bonus.

Steyn recorded her third Up Run victory and fifth Comrades title overall (three Up, two Down); she became only the second woman after Elena Nurgalieva (eight wins) to win the Comrades Marathon five times.

The official results portal results.finishtime.co.za was behind a bot verification check at access time and could not be read; the podium and top-five figures above are transcribed from the CMA official post-race blog.
